seo.title: HasApp — manage your business online
seo.description: HasApp is a business management platform: accounting, reports and automation in one place.

hero.headline: Run Your Business Without Notebooks and Spreadsheets
hero.description: HasApp is an on-premise CRM and management system for small and medium businesses in Turkmenistan: deals, inventory, payroll, and work time — all in one place. Deployment takes 1–3 days.

features.headline: Everything to run your business
features.description: Sales, inventory, finance and HR — all in one system, no scattered spreadsheets and no lost leads.

items.label: CRM & Sales
items.title: Deals, leads and clients
items.subtitle: No more lost requests or scattered spreadsheets: sales pipeline, client base and products — all in one system, with full visibility into every deal.

items.label: Inventory
items.title: Real-time
items.subtitle: Receipts, purchases, write-offs, returns and stocktaking — no Excel, no «shortages nobody can explain».

items.label: Work time
items.title: Working hours tracking
items.subtitle: Timesheets, employee reports and vacation schedules. Already have a time recorder? We'll connect it and sync it with HasApp. Don't have one yet? Our manager will recommend what to buy.

items.label: Payroll
items.title: Employee payroll
items.subtitle: Payroll calculation right in the system — no spreadsheets and no manual recalculation.

items.label: Flexibility & Security
items.title: Configurable
items.subtitle: Custom fields, categories and access rights — 300+ permissions in the system. Multi-currency and multi-company support for businesses with several legal entities. Works even offline, with data staying on your own server.

items.label: Email
items.title: Your own email
items.subtitle: Connect your mailbox and work with emails without leaving the system: receive and send messages in the same window as the rest of your work.

items.label: Reports
items.title: Key business figures
items.subtitle: Widgets for sales, clients, inventory, projects and finance: add the ones you need and keep the whole picture in view.

items.label: AI
items.title: An assistant
items.subtitle: AI chats inside HasApp: create chats and ask questions without leaving the system.

howItWorks.headline: Up and running in 3 steps
howItWorks.description: From your request to a fully working system — just 1–3 days, no complicated rollout.

steps.label: STEP 1
steps.title: Leave a request
steps.subtitle: Tell us a bit about your business — industry, team size and contact details. It takes just a couple of minutes.

steps.label: STEP 2
steps.title: We get in touch
steps.subtitle: Our manager will contact you, go over your business needs and answer your questions. We'll suggest which modules fit you best.

steps.label: STEP 3
steps.title: Installation and launch
steps.subtitle: We deploy the system for your business, set up access rights and train your staff — in just 1–3 days.

faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: We've gathered answers to the most common questions about HasApp — if you can't find yours, reach out to us.

items.question: What is HasApp?
items.answer: HasApp is a business management system: sales, inventory, finance, HR and communication all in one place.

items.question: How secure is my data in HasApp?
items.answer: Your data stays on your own server, with access controlled through a permission system (300+ access rights).

items.question: How does the system work?
items.answer: You register your company, connect the modules you need, and start working — deployment takes 1–3 days.

items.question: Can I customize the system for my business?
items.answer: Yes, every module lets you add custom fields, categories, and rearrange interface elements to fit your workflow.

items.question: Does HasApp support multiple companies?
items.answer: Yes, the system supports multiple companies and multiple currencies for businesses with several legal entities.

items.question: How do I get started with HasApp?
items.answer: Leave a request — we'll deploy the system for your business and configure access rights within 1–3 days.

items.question: Can HasApp track employee working hours?
items.answer: Yes, including support for a physical clock-in/clock-out time recorder.

items.question: What plans does HasApp offer?
items.answer: The license is a one-time purchase: the Basic plan for up to 10 users — $1000, and the Standard plan for up to 50 users — $2000. See the Pricing section for details.

items.question: Can I try HasApp before buying?
items.answer: Right now it works like this: you leave a request, we get in touch, discuss your needs and install the system. Automatic demo access is planned for the future, so you'll be able to try the system right after submitting a request.

sections.title: 1. General provisions
sections.text: This policy describes what personal data the HasApp website (the “Site”) collects, how it is used and how it is protected. The data operator is LTM Studio (the “Operator”), Ashgabat, Turkmenistan. By submitting a form on the Site, you agree to the terms of this policy.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
sections.intro: Through the contact form we receive:
items: the text of the message you write yourself.
sections.text: In addition, the Cloudflare Turnstile service is used to protect against spam and bots. It may process technical data about your device and your IP address. We do not collect bank card details or other sensitive information.

sections.title: 3. Purposes of processing
sections.intro: We need the data only to:
items: contact you and respond to your request;
tell you about HasApp and the terms of getting started;
protect the Site from spam and abuse.
sections.text: We do not use your data for mailings without your consent and we do not sell it to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Storage and protection
sections.text: Requests are stored on the Operator’s server and passed to the employees who respond to them. We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data from loss, unauthorized access and disclosure. Data is kept for as long as needed to respond to your request and continue working with you, and is then deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: 5. Disclosure to third parties
sections.text: We do not share your data with third parties, except where required by law and for the services needed to run the Site (Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection and an email service for delivering request notifications).

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.text: The Site uses only technical cookies that are needed for it to work (for example, remembering your chosen language and color theme). We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.text: You can ask at any time what data about you is stored, correct it or ask for it to be deleted. To do so, write to info{'@'}ltm.studio. We will reply within a reasonable time.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.text: We may update this policy. The current version is always available on the Site, and the date of the last update is shown at the top.
